feature: Opt-in per-frame mean-water triangle cache for wave-domain construction
status: Accepted source optimization with exact surface/domain outputs, native/worker lifetimes and 33 exact rendered pairs. No new export, APK or delivery archive.

implementation.change: Cache unposed triangle anchors, projected edges, vertex heights and determinant once per query frame. Enable only for the existing dense wave-domain batch via begin_frame(false,true). Other callers keep the original triangle loop and allocate no triangle payload.
implementation.precision: Preserve original Vector2/Vector3 rounding, float64 height subtraction and determinants, barycentric tolerances, iteration/tie order, highest-surface selection, material ownership and live lava checks. Cache invalidates with the original begin_frame generation and existing mesh-identity/weak-node/LRU rules.
implementation.memory: 45 packed bytes per allocated triangle on these single-precision builds; lazy allocation only for nonempty queried buckets. Surface probes retain 173880-199800 additional packed CPU bytes (0.166-0.191 MiB); dictionary/allocator overhead is not measured. The existing 16-sector LRU bounds retention, and clear releases every record. No new GPU resource.
implementation.unchanged: Authored wave evaluation, phase-grid constructor, navigation, solver, worker lifecycle, clocks, shaders, settings/defaults, independent cloud controls and .8/.9 fixes.

profile.interpretation: Per fresh domain, 44784-55416 vertex-cache lookups serve only 1372-1634 newly evaluated vertices. Instrumentation adds substantial overhead; profiled elapsed times are not used as optimization measurements. Surface construction separately takes 6.0-6.8 ms in this sample.

cost.method: Two fresh-process ABBA domain runs per platform; median across both reference arms and both candidate arms. Fresh includes the Surface constructor and complete _domain call; cached uses the two repeated origins; moving uses the two initial shifts. Equal inputs and checks outside the timed calls. Hidden held terrain, no other desktop engine process. CPU timings, not GPU time, whole-game FPS, map load or total water-level rebuild.
cost.android: Retroid Pocket 5 / Android 33 / Adreno 650; existing private Compatibility runtime. GPU is not what is timed.
cost.linux: Linux / AMD Ryzen 5950X, headless CPU runs. Separate rendered checks use RTX3090 Ti.
cost.query_scope: Direct 1024-query ABBA batches exclude constructor and begin_frame. Mean, posed, default waves-disabled, and cache toggle controls are included. See raw rows for timings, hits and retained bytes.

surface-desktop05.scope: CPU query batch timing, excluding constructors and comparisons; no FPS claim.

surface-android04.scope: CPU query batch timing, excluding constructors and comparisons; no FPS claim.

cost.limits: Cold domain cost remains 52-59 ms on the sampled Android maps. Cached domain medians vary by at most 0.13 ms here; no cached-build speedup is claimed. Default/posed queries retain their original per-triangle arithmetic and are near baseline in final batches.

correctness.coverage: 346 surface assertions per platform covering exact serialized heights/slopes/owners, highest/tied overlap, slivers/degeneracy, barycentric edges, nonfinite/negative points, offset and wave clocks, optional-cache toggles, live lava flags, node/terrain transforms, same-frame mesh replacement/removal/recreation, 16-sector eviction, clear and freed terrain. 1701 domain assertions per base run across zones 1/11/8 and 1648 for LiA zones 1/10/26 cover fractional origins, currents, exclusions, offsets and exact domain/cache/invalidation keys.
correctness.lifetime: 31/0 Linux, 31/0 Android native, 31/0 Android scalar worker; worker is active on clear and joined safely.

rendered.scope: Real interaction controller with explicit selected Field/query script identity checks. Linux and Android Compatibility river/current scene; Android Mobile standard water. Eleven off/empty/lingering/held/alternate-liquid/disable/reenable captures per pair. The final Linux candidate render overlaps one unrelated headless Godot process; exact image/correctness results remain valid, and no render timing is claimed.

rejected_or_intermediate.result: First cache prototype passed exact outputs and reduced cold work, but inserted per-triangle branching into posed queries; observed roughly 5-8% Linux and 3-5% Android regressions. Rejected.
Separated mean-query path, then skipped empty buckets. Numerically passing intermediate designs. Final adds explicit opt-in so sparse/default consumers do not allocate or fill triangle storage.

Fixture adapter parse failure: inherited installed Field statically types Surface.begin_frame with one argument. New production code and full-field tests accept the optional second argument. Corrected only the render adapter with a cast to the selected query subclass; reruns pass. Failed records retained, excluded from acceptance.

runtime_scope.surface: The exact changed begin_frame/sample/helper bodies are loaded as a typed child of the installed Surface. Unchanged constructor, sector index and vertex methods are inherited and source-audited.
runtime_scope.field: CPU/lifetime tests load the complete production Field with only its Surface preload redirected. Render tests use the exact domain body with the same new query factory and an old-runtime type cast, inside the installed interaction controller; actual contacts also use the selected query.
runtime_scope.android: Existing org.cursedlands.performance app and unchanged prior native validation adapter. Native/worker/domain/render fixtures load the two already-qualified absent water kernels. Both Compatibility render arms retain the accepted a916f95 WaterTextureData substitution; Mobile uses the unchanged native shader path. No engine, pack or installed helper replaced.
runtime_scope.limits: Source/method substitution is not a fresh complete-current-source package. Original RMX3890/Adreno610 and RTX3050 report causes, Windows/device acceptance and the distinct Adreno650 Mobile cloud/material lighting flicker remain open.

next_work: Cold query/constructor/index and remaining water-level/positive-waterfall geometry costs remain measurable. Surface phase-grid construction takes about 6-7 ms on this Android even for an unposed-only consumer; any lazy/shared approach still needs an exact phase/ownership/lifetime check. Do not resume playthroughs, create packages, or repeat the Mobile shader ablation grid without new evidence.
